bullets.section: New booze I’m enjoying more than I should —
bullets.title: Desert Door Texas sotol
bullets.note: I was recently introduced to this at the amazing [Trans-Pecos festival](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/p9urq7wddu9hl9n82/7df7h8h02p0w3/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbGNvc21pY28uY29tL2V2ZW50L3RyYW5zLXBlY29zLWZlc3RpdmFsLW9mLW11c2ljLWxvdmUtMjAxOC8=) held by [Liz Lambert](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/p9urq7wddu9hl9n82/zvtghnho2rop5/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE4LzA2LzE0L2xpei1sYW1iZXJ0Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1jb252ZXJ0a2l0JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj01YmY=) at [El Cosmico](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/p9urq7wddu9hl9n82/x6cph6hnvdn9o/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbGNvc21pY28uY29tLw==) in Marfa, Texas. From the [Wikipedia entry on sotol](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/p9urq7wddu9hl9n82/kvsmh6h80286w/aHR0cHM6Ly9lbi53aWtpcGVkaWEub3JnL3dpa2kvU290b2w=): “Sotol is a distilled spirit sourced from _Dasylirion wheeleri_, Asparagaceae (commonly known as Desert Spoon or, in Spanish, sotol), a plant that grows in northern Mexico, New Mexico, west Texas, and the Texas Hill Country. It is known as the state drink of Chihuahua, Durango and Coahuila, and is also currently produced in Central Texas. There are few commercial examples available.” This low-calorie Desert Door brand has just three ingredients—wild sotol, organic yeast, and purified natural Texas water. It tastes something like a blend of tequila and mezcal with a hot-flush finish.

bullets.title: Publius Cornelius Scipio Africanus
bullets.note: (236–183 BC), also known as Scipio the African, Scipio Africanus-Major, Scipio Africanus the Elder, and Scipio the Great, was a Roman general and later consul often regarded as one of the greatest generals and military strategists of all time. His main achievements are thought to have occurred during the Second Punic War, in which he is best known for defeating Hannibal at the final battle at Zama in 202 BC, one of the feats that earned him the agnomen “Africanus."
